relationships.subject: laser irradiation
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings indicate that after being irradiated with 808 nm light from a diode laser at 2.5 W for 25 s, mice produce relatively stable pain responses, with peak pain sensitivity reached on the 14th day.

relationships.subject: laser irradiation
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with the control group, the excitability of small DRG neurons in the laser-treated group was significantly elevated.

key_findings: 808 nm laser at 2.5 W for 25 s produces stable mechanical pain with peak at day 14 and skin inflammation.
Proteomics showed differential expression of S100A8/A9, TRPV1 and IL-17A.
